Your body transforms, becoming more sleek and lithe. Your body weight is reduced by a half, rendering you unnaturally light and quick on your hooves. Your hide becomes smooth with a texture like carved wood. Your crystal antlers grow thinner and the points flatten like thin blades.

  • Attribute Increase: Your Dexterity and Wisdom both increase by 1.
